name: 3-2-1 crack minus the pre-2020 median
license: Calculated from US government series stored in this archive
method: CRACK_321 minus its train median. Train median 16.739 dollars per barrel. CRACK_321 is ((2 * RBOB_F1 + HO_F1) / 3) * 42 minus RCLC1. A date is absent when any input is absent. The futures workbooks end before the spot series.
